explainTr: Karışık koşul, geçmişteki bir olayın şimdiki sonucunu anlatır: If I had studied nursing, I would be a nurse now. (Geçmişte okumadım, bu yüzden şimdi hemşire değilim.)
Ters yönde de olur: şimdiki bir özellik geçmişte farklı bir sonuç verirdi: If I were more confident, I would have applied last year.
Kural: if kısmı ve sonuç kısmı farklı zamanlardan olabilir. Önce hangi zamanı anlatmak istediğini düşün, sonra yapıyı seç.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Okusaydım şimdi hemşire olurdum' diyebilirsin; zaman ek ile anlaşılır. İngilizcede her bölüm kendi zamanını ister: geçmiş için had + V3, şimdi için would + fiil.

reading.title: The other road
reading.text:
Hafsa sat at the kitchen table with a cup of tea and a pile of papers. She was reading about the requirements for becoming a substitute teacher in her state. Most districts wanted a college degree, a background check, and some experience with children. Hafsa had the experience, but she did not have a degree from an American university.

"If I had finished my studies in Turkey, I would have a degree now," she said to herself. Then she smiled sadly. "And if I hadn't married young, I might have a different career today." She did not regret her family, but she often wondered about the other road.

Her neighbor Linda stopped by with some cookies. "You look serious," Linda said. Hafsa explained her problem. Linda listened carefully and then told her own story. "Ten years ago, I decided not to take a job in Chicago. If I had accepted that offer, I would be a manager now, and I would earn much more money. But I would also be far from my friends. Every decision has a consequence."

"So what should I do?" Hafsa asked.

"Take a smaller step," Linda said. "Many community colleges have affordable programs. The tuition is not too high, and you can enroll in evening classes. If you start this fall, you could graduate in two years. If you wait, you will only lose time."

That night, Hafsa talked to her son Emre. He was excited. "Mom, if you were afraid of risks, you wouldn't have moved here in the first place. You have already done something hard." Hafsa laughed. He was right. If she had stayed in Isparta, her life would be easier, but she would not have this opportunity.

The next morning, she called the community college. A friendly advisor explained the process and told her about a scholarship for adult students. "If you had called last month, you would have missed the early discount," the advisor joked. "But you're lucky. It's still open." Hafsa wrote the date in her calendar and felt, for the first time in weeks, that she was moving forward.

options: She could not find a school.
She did not have an American college degree.
She had no time at all.

script.speaker: Advisor
script.text: Community college admissions. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Hello. My name is Hafsa Odabasi. I want to enroll in an education program, but I don't have a degree.

script.speaker: Advisor
script.text: That's fine. You can start with our certificate program. Do you have any experience with children?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes. I volunteered at my son's school for three years.

script.speaker: Advisor
script.text: Excellent. That is real experience. Now, about the tuition: it is two hundred dollars per credit.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Hmm. If I had known earlier, I would have saved some money. Can I afford it with a scholarship?

script.speaker: Advisor
script.text: Possibly. If you had applied last month, you would have gotten the early discount. But you can still apply for the adult learner scholarship.

script.speaker: Advisor
script.text: You need two references and a short essay about your background. The deadline is November twentieth.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I will start the essay tonight. When do the evening classes begin?

script.speaker: Advisor
script.text: In January. If you enroll now, you will get a place in the Tuesday class.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Wonderful. Please send me the application link.

writing.promptTr: Hayatındaki bir kararı ve sonuçlarını anlat (ör. başka bir ülkeye taşınmak, okumak, çalışmak). En az üç karışık koşul cümlesi kullan: geçmiş neden + şimdiki sonuç ya da şimdiki özellik + geçmiş sonuç. 120-180 kelime.
writing.promptEn: Write about an important decision in your life and its consequences. Use at least three mixed conditional sentences (120-180 words).
frames: One important decision in my life was ...
If I had ..., I would ... now.
If I were ..., I would have ...
Every decision has a consequence because ...
writing.model: One important decision in my life was moving to the United States. I made this decision five years ago, and it changed everything. If I had stayed in Isparta, I would have a quiet life now, and I would see my friends every week. But I would not speak English every day, and I would not have the dream of becoming a substitute teacher. Sometimes I think about the other path. If I were a braver person, I would have studied more when I was young. If I had finished a university degree, I would have a different job today. However, I do not regret my choice. Every decision has a consequence, and I try to learn from mine. My son Emre says that if I had not taken this risk, we would not have so many new opportunities. He is right. I am still learning, and I am proud of my progress.
checklistTr: En az üç karışık koşul cümlen var mı?
Geçmiş neden için had + V3, şimdiki sonuç için would + fiil kullandın mı?
Şimdiki özellik için were/past simple ve geçmiş sonuç için would have + V3 kullandın mı?
